title: Exploring Changes in Nation Perception with Nationality-Assigned Personas in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Assigning 193 different nationality personas to LLMs and prompting them to associate positive or negative adjectives with specific nations. The evaluation measures Response Percentage (RP) and Positively Mention Rate (PMR) to identify favorability and representational disparities toward specific countries or regions (e.g., Western-centric bias).
